mobnumericalindicator.config.title: Mob Numerical Indicator
mobnumericalindicator.config.show_when_a: Show indicators when a mob is actively targeting a player or entity.
mobnumericalindicator.config.show_when_d: Show indicators when a mob is below 100% health.
mobnumericalindicator.config.show_when_l: Show indicators when the player's crosshair is hovering over the mob.
mobnumericalindicator.config.show_always: §7If all three options above are disabled, indicators will show on all mobs always.
mobnumericalindicator.config.show_when_i: Show indicators even if the mob has the Invisibility status effect.
mobnumericalindicator.config.show_armor_: Show the armor indicator even when the mob is not wearing any armor.
mobnumericalindicator.config.show_text_s: Show a shadow behind all indicator text.
mobnumericalindicator.config.scale.toolt: Adjust the baseline size of icons and text.
mobnumericalindicator.config.max_distanc: Maximum distance in blocks at which indicators remain visible.
